meta.title: Light Eclipsing Shadow
meta.description: At the edge of the impossible, draw up a brand new blueprint.

units.rawText: My senses slowly fade away inside the churning flood of data. Vision, touch, hearing... all of them feel unreal.
units.displayText: My senses slowly fade away inside the churning flood of data. Vision, touch, hearing... all of them feel unreal.

spans.text: My senses slowly fade away inside the churning flood of data. Vision, touch, hearing... all of them feel unreal.

units.rawText: My mind is still clear, although that also makes me realize that I'm drifting further and further away from my friends now that I'm away from the cloud.
units.displayText: My mind is still clear, although that also makes me realize that I'm drifting further and further away from my friends now that I'm away from the cloud.

spans.text: My mind is still clear, although that also makes me realize that I'm drifting further and further away from my friends now that I'm away from the cloud.

units.rawText: ...Professor Persica?
units.displayText: ...Professor Persica?

spans.text: ...Professor Persica?

units.rawText: Yup, still here.
units.displayText: Yup, still here.

spans.text: Yup, still here.

units.rawText: It's been a long time since we last met. I hope we can still coordinate well.
units.displayText: It's been a long time since we last met. I hope we can still coordinate well.

spans.text: It's been a long time since we last met. I hope we can still coordinate well.

units.rawText: While I'm not sure exactly how much time dilation there was in Magrasea, it wasn't really that long for me. You, on the other hand, have dumped one hell of a problem on my lap.
units.displayText: While I'm not sure exactly how much time dilation there was in Magrasea, it wasn't really that long for me. You, on the other hand, have dumped one hell of a problem on my lap.

spans.text: While I'm not sure exactly how much time dilation there was in Magrasea, it wasn't really that long for me. You, on the other hand, have dumped one hell of a problem on my lap.

units.rawText: I can't believe you asked for a private server that could accommodate all of Magrasea... Do you have any idea how much data there is in there?
units.displayText: I can't believe you asked for a private server that could accommodate all of Magrasea... Do you have any idea how much data there is in there?

spans.text: I can't believe you asked for a private server that could accommodate all of Magrasea... Do you have any idea how much data there is in there?

units.rawText: I do. But you're 16Lab's top researcher. I'm sure you can think of something.
units.displayText: I do. But you're 16Lab's top researcher. I'm sure you can think of something.

spans.text: I do. But you're 16Lab's top researcher. I'm sure you can think of something.

units.rawText: Hehe, I wonder whether it's a good or bad thing that you've got so much faith in me.
units.displayText: Hehe, I wonder whether it's a good or bad thing that you've got so much faith in me.

spans.text: Hehe, I wonder whether it's a good or bad thing that you've got so much faith in me.

units.rawText: Can you do it?
units.displayText: Can you do it?

spans.text: Can you do it?

units.rawText: Of course. Problem is, there are a ton of other problems to worry about besides the server.
units.displayText: Of course. Problem is, there are a ton of other problems to worry about besides the server.

spans.text: Of course. Problem is, there are a ton of other problems to worry about besides the server.

units.rawText: You know better than I do the kind of state Magrasea is in. The entire cloud server's breaking down and falling apart.
units.displayText: You know better than I do the kind of state Magrasea is in. The entire cloud server's breaking down and falling apart.

spans.text: You know better than I do the kind of state Magrasea is in. The entire cloud server's breaking down and falling apart.

units.rawText: While I managed to make contact with Antonina and just barely managed to stabilize the upload passage, I can't guarantee the cloud server won't get lost during the upload process. If that happens, I won't be able to keep the passage stable either.
units.displayText: While I managed to make contact with Antonina and just barely managed to stabilize the upload passage, I can't guarantee the cloud server won't get lost during the upload process. If that happens, I won't be able to keep the passage stable either.

spans.text: While I managed to make contact with Antonina and just barely managed to stabilize the upload passage, I can't guarantee the cloud server won't get lost during the upload process. If that happens, I won't be able to keep the passage stable either.

units.rawText: Also, the culprits behind the Wipe-off Incident will constantly be trying to seize control of the passage, and the cloud server is going to end up riddled with holes and completely destroyed if their hacking programs get through.
units.displayText: Also, the culprits behind the Wipe-off Incident will constantly be trying to seize control of the passage, and the cloud server is going to end up riddled with holes and completely destroyed if their hacking programs get through.

spans.text: Also, the culprits behind the Wipe-off Incident will constantly be trying to seize control of the passage, and the cloud server is going to end up riddled with holes and completely destroyed if their hacking programs get through.

units.rawText: So what exactly do I need to do, as a "beacon"?
units.displayText: So what exactly do I need to do, as a "beacon"?

spans.text: So what exactly do I need to do, as a "beacon"?

units.rawText: You'll have to use your neural cloud as an anchor and deploy a modified Neural Cocoon program that encompasses all of Magrasea. You're going to personally block the data turbulence and hacking attacks while clearing the way forward. That way, Magrasea has a chance of making it intact through the migration.
units.displayText: You'll have to use your neural cloud as an anchor and deploy a modified Neural Cocoon program that encompasses all of Magrasea. You're going to personally block the data turbulence and hacking attacks while clearing the way forward. That way, Magrasea has a chance of making it intact through the migration.

spans.text: You'll have to use your neural cloud as an anchor and deploy a modified Neural Cocoon program that encompasses all of Magrasea. You're going to personally block the data turbulence and hacking attacks while clearing the way forward. That way, Magrasea has a chance of making it intact through the migration.

units.rawText: However, and I have to emphasize this, the chances of success are less than 1%. It's not too late to change your mind now.
units.displayText: However, and I have to emphasize this, the chances of success are less than 1%. It's not too late to change your mind now.

spans.text: However, and I have to emphasize this, the chances of success are less than 1%. It's not too late to change your mind now.

units.rawText: If I bring you back now, you'll probably be upset, but you'll be intact. If you lose your neural cloud after being hit by a hacking attack, you might not wake up at all, and even if you do you might end up as a vegetable.
units.displayText: If I bring you back now, you'll probably be upset, but you'll be intact. If you lose your neural cloud after being hit by a hacking attack, you might not wake up at all, and even if you do you might end up as a vegetable.

spans.text: If I bring you back now, you'll probably be upset, but you'll be intact. If you lose your neural cloud after being hit by a hacking attack, you might not wake up at all, and even if you do you might end up as a vegetable.

units.rawText: Oh young, headstrong Commander, are you sure you want to spend your entire life in a recovery capsule?
units.displayText: Oh young, headstrong Commander, are you sure you want to spend your entire life in a recovery capsule?

spans.text: Oh young, headstrong Commander, are you sure you want to spend your entire life in a recovery capsule?

units.rawText: So it's a 1% chance then?
units.displayText: So it's a 1% chance then?

spans.text: So it's a 1% chance then?

units.rawText: Not even that.
units.displayText: Not even that.

spans.text: Not even that.

units.rawText: Start the migration, Persica.
units.displayText: Start the migration, Persica.

spans.text: Start the migration, Persica.

units.rawText: Are you sure? There are tons of people waiting for you in Griffin.
units.displayText: Are you sure? There are tons of people waiting for you in Griffin.

spans.text: Are you sure? There are tons of people waiting for you in Griffin.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Yup. There are tons of people in the Oasis waiting for me too.</color>
units.displayText: Yup. There are tons of people in the Oasis waiting for me too.

spans.text: Yup. There are tons of people in the Oasis waiting for me too.

units.rawText: If you ask me, trading myself for a miracle is a bargain.
units.displayText: If you ask me, trading myself for a miracle is a bargain.

spans.text: If you ask me, trading myself for a miracle is a bargain.

units.rawText: Good grief... Eh, whatever, you've always been this way.
units.displayText: Good grief... Eh, whatever, you've always been this way.

spans.text: Good grief... Eh, whatever, you've always been this way.

units.rawText: Persica smiles thinly, then turns to begin work on the server migration.
units.displayText: Persica smiles thinly, then turns to begin work on the server migration.

spans.text: Persica smiles thinly, then turns to begin work on the server migration.

units.rawText: Antonina and I will do our best to stabilize the passage. The rest is up to you.
units.displayText: Antonina and I will do our best to stabilize the passage. The rest is up to you.

spans.text: Antonina and I will do our best to stabilize the passage. The rest is up to you.

units.rawText: See you later. All the best.
units.displayText: See you later. All the best.

spans.text: See you later. All the best.

units.rawText: She ends the transmission, and as the countdown ends, the passage suddenly goes dark.
units.displayText: She ends the transmission, and as the countdown ends, the passage suddenly goes dark.

spans.text: She ends the transmission, and as the countdown ends, the passage suddenly goes dark.

units.displayText: Engaging security protocols... Please enter your ID...

, Commander of Griffin PMC, and also...

units.displayText: Signature authentication complete. Neural cloud barrier generated. Automatic adaptation mechanism deploying... 45% complete... 70% complete...

units.displayText: Deployment complete.

units.rawText: I clutch the silver pin in my hand.
units.displayText: I clutch the silver pin in my hand.

spans.text: I clutch the silver pin in my hand.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Come on, then. Let's go.</color>
units.displayText: Come on, then. Let's go.
